name: @powerhousedao/knowledge-note
description: Team-wide institutional memory system — atomic knowledge notes with typed content, structured links, lifecycle states, and provenance tracking.

config.name: AUTH_ENABLED
config.description: "true" or "false". Verify Renown bearer tokens and resolve the caller's identity.

config.name: ADMINS
config.description: Comma-separated Ethereum addresses that bypass every permission check (supreme admins). Give it at least two.

config.name: DOCUMENT_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED
config.description: "true" or "false". Enable per-document READ/WRITE/ADMIN grants; runs the permission migrations at boot.

config.name: DEFAULT_PROTECTION
config.description: "true" or "false". Documents are protected by default and need an explicit grant to read or write.

config.name: REQUIRE_AUTHENTICATED_CALLER
config.description: "true" or "false". Reject anonymous GraphQL callers with 401 before any resolver runs. Requires AUTH_ENABLED=true.

config.name: CONVERT_SERVICE_URL
config.description: Base URL of the document conversion service, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:5011. Unset is supported: GET convert/health reports configured=false and POST convert answers 503 CONVERT_NOT_CONFIGURED.

config.name: CONVERT_SERVICE_API_KEY
config.description: Sent as X-Api-Key when the conversion service requires one. Omit for a service that is not authenticated; when set, the URL is treated as a managed deployment and is not probed at boot.

config.name: CONVERT_SERVICE_LOCAL
config.description: Assume the conversion service is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:5011 when CONVERT_SERVICE_URL is unset. A development convenience; nothing is started.

config.name: CONVERT_SERVICE_AUTOSTART
config.description: Deprecated, kept so existing setups keep working: now means only 'assume the conversion service is on http://127.0.0.1:5011'. It no longer starts anything — the engine ships as its own container image. Prefer CONVERT_SERVICE_URL, or CONVERT_SERVICE_LOCAL for the same localhost default.

config.name: EMBEDDER_CDN_BASE
config.description: Test override for where the graph indexer fetches its embedding model and onnxruntime wasm from. Normally derived from the module URL, so a deployed Switchboard needs nothing here; set it (e.g. http://localhost:8000/dist/node/) to exercise the deployed path from a local checkout.
